Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

**(1) Chat/Thread row under Projects:**
There is **no** chat or thread row under the "Projects" section. The text displayed directly below the "Projects" header is **"No projects"**, indicating that the list is currently empty.

**(2) Main Area Content:**
The main area displays a **welcome screen** (specifically a sign-in/onboarding prompt). It features the heading **"What should we work on?"** and instructions to **"Start a new chat or open one from the sidebar."**

**(3) Context Card / Metadata Text:**
There are two distinct text blocks fitting this description:
*   **Sign-in Card:** Contains the text: **"Sign in to get started"**, followed by **"Sign in to start using Codex."**
*   **Review Agent Card:** Displays the title **"Review Agent"** and the metadata/description: **"Find actionable bugs in code changes"** (with a status tag of **"Built-in"** on the right).

**(4) Bottom Banner Text:**
At the very bottom left of the sidebar window, the status text reads: **"App-server online"** (preceded by a green dot).
